name: NICE CG142 — autism in adults: diagnosis and management
description: NICE clinical guideline CG142 covering identification, assessment, diagnosis and management of autism in adults.
intended_use: Inspect current professional guidance on adult autism assessment, care and support.
audience_or_context: Adults, families, supporters and professionals using NICE guidance in England and Wales.
limitations: The guideline cannot determine whether an individual is autistic or which local service will accept a referral.
Some terminology and recommendations reflect the date and clinical framing of the guideline; it is updated through NICE's review process.
conflicts_of_interest: NICE is the public guideline producer for the NHS in England and Wales; ND Oracle records the guidance route and keeps lived-experience and contested framing separate.

provenance.method: Current first-party identity, access route and stated function checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records what the resource is and how to reach it without adopting provider claims of benefit.
